scope: File-level source-license review only. CIF bytes, structural values, material declarations and historical scientific findings are unchanged. No publication-wide rights grant is inferred.

cod_policy.scope: COD states that its data and database are dedicated to the public domain under CC0; original research articles are separate.

cif_comparison_method: Remove only complete comment lines beginning #$Date: or #$URL:, preserving every other byte and line ending. Exact SHA-256 values are also retained for each original/served file.

files.qualification: Only SVN Date and URL comment lines differ between primary/mirror variants. All other CIF bytes, including legacy headers, are identical. Original journal articles are outside this data grant.

files.qualification: The indexed institutional record displays the thesis with an unpopulated license column; that incomplete observation is not evidence that no grant exists. Public availability and a contributor dedication do not establish original thesis rights. This is not a finding that factual numerical values are copyrighted or non-free.
files.required_action: Obtain a dataset-specific grant from the relevant rights holder, or a documented numerical-facts/rights assessment accepted by the downstream reviewer.

limits: COD grants are recorded as source declarations, not independent authentication of every underlying contributor right.
HTTP failures at the thesis repository are access limitations, not licensing evidence. Unverified source terms remain unspecified.
